## 0.17.1 - 2026-05-27
### Added
* plugins/docker-registry: expose via Ingress for k8s runtime so the kubelet can pull plugin images over HTTPS with a trusted certificate. Includes auto-generated dockerconfigjson pull secret and K8S_IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS injection. CRI runtime is unchanged (uses internal service name). ([Pull #292](https://github.com/cycloidio/ansible-cycloid-onprem/issues/292))
